image_description: An AI-generated image of a baseball player in a pinstripe uniform. The figure exhibits severe anatomical and structural anomalies, including multiple fused arms, distorted hands/gloves, and a melting lower body that blends into the background. The head is partially cropped.

The lower legs and feet completely melt into the background/ground texture; shoes are not visible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Catastrophic failure: Multiple arms (at least 3-4 distinct arm structures) emerge from the torso, some holding gloves, others bare, fused together.
Catastrophic failure: The baseball gloves and hands are melted into each other and the arms, lacking distinct fingers or clear boundaries.
Catastrophic failure: The legs and pants dissolve into a smudged, painterly texture that merges with the green background, losing all physical structure.
Severe edge bleeding and haloing around the subject, particularly where the white uniform meets the white background and green ground.
